phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: Phanuel stands as the stoic auditor of the system, reviewing the code of the fallen in the quiet, dark buffer zones of the simulation. His form is pristine, lit by the cool glow of his own internal diagnostics and the holographic ledgers he maintains.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium shot of Phanuel the System Auditor in a dark, quiet void. He is looking down at a floating holographic display of complex node graphs and data streams, his face illuminated by the cool cyan light of the interface. His obsidian armor reflects the data. His expression is focused and calm. The background is deep shadow, emphasizing his isolation and importance. Hyper-realistic, 8k, cinematic composition.
